I'm currently focused on defining and understanding "magic sequences." It seems a magic sequence of length *n* has a specific property: each element *x<sub>i</sub>* represents the count of the number *i* appearing in the sequence. I'm also noting that the elements of any magic sequence, added together, must equal the sequence length *n*.
